meta.name: version-bump
meta.description: Automated semantic versioning and release workflow for Claude Code plugins. Handles version increments across package.json, marketplace.json, plugin.json manifests, build verification, git tagging, GitHub releases, and changelog generation. NPM publishing is the final human-required handoff because the maintainer raised npm security.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动完成版本号递增、构建校验、git 标签与发布说明生成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次发版都要手动改版本号、打标签、写发布说明。
copy.tagline_en: Automate version bumps, build checks, git tags, and changelog generation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if every release means manually editing versions, tagging, and writing release notes.

howto.what: 把插件发版流程交给 Claude:它判断该升 PATCH、MINOR 还是 MAJOR,同步修改八个清单文件里的版本号,构建验证、打 git tag、推送、创建 GitHub release,并重新生成 CHANGELOG。最后一步 npm publish 必须由人手动执行。
howto.when: 当你准备为 Claude Code 插件发布新版本时接管——无论是修 bug、加功能还是破坏性改动。它会先从 git remote 判断仓库归属,再走完整个发版流程。

say.text: 帮我发个 patch 版本,升版本号并走完发布流程
say.note: 它会改版本号、构建、打 tag 并推送

say.text: 检查八个清单文件的版本号是否都一致
say.note: 用 git grep 核对新旧版本号

howto.what_en: Claude runs the plugin release flow: decides PATCH/MINOR/MAJOR, bumps the version in eight manifest files, builds and verifies, tags, pushes, creates a GitHub release, and regenerates CHANGELOG. npm publish stays a human step.
howto.when_en: Use when releasing a new version of a Claude Code plugin — bug fix, feature, or breaking change. It reads git remote to identify the repo, then runs the release workflow.

say_en.text: Cut a patch release: bump the version and run the whole workflow
say_en.note: It edits versions, builds, tags and pushes

say_en.text: This one adds features, so MINOR — with CHANGELOG and GitHub release
say_en.note: It stops and waits for you to run npm publish

say_en.text: Check that all eight manifest files have the same version
say_en.note: Uses git grep to match old and new versions
